scope: Private Auto v2 experiment; preserve the public library and v1 observations.
root_causes: Speed extrapolation requested 1383202 slots after 86434 tokens; final count was 90180.
Memory clipped a 65538 forecast to 65534; the next growth applied a 81917 floor near EOF.
V1 speed copy-pressure threshold >2*n cannot activate with its 1.5x floor and initial 256 slots over the representable vector range. V2 uses >1.5*n.
changes: Byte ceiling counts speculative slots beyond the scanned pending token, rounded down by sizeof(Token).
The geometric floor overrides too-small byte ceilings; record actual overrides rather than promise a hard total-memory cap.
Remaining source bytes provide a proven upper bound on remaining non-EOF tokens. Clamping to that bound guarantees no further growth and safely bypasses the floor once.
selection: Calibration: one timing round, 3 samples x 2 iterations; exploratory only. Per goal select candidates satisfying known non-tiny memory gates, compare geometric-mean time ratios, treat within 10% of fastest as ties and choose the lowest worst peak/oracle. If none satisfy memory gates, select lowest normalized worst peak and mark unqualified.
final_measurement: Selected pair plus both fixed modes and both frozen v1 modes: 6 rotating rounds x 5 samples x 3 iterations, separately on 75 known and 16 newly generated inputs.

joint_targets.non_tiny: Production Balanced median parse >=1ms. Report every input regardless.
joint_targets.meaning: Empirical targets on the measured machine, not wall-clock/allocator guarantees. No target weakening after results.

holdout.generation: Only after selected byte budgets, controller source and executable hashes are frozen. Do not retune afterward.

structural.tail: No further growth after a proven tail-bound reservation
structural.journal: 512 fixed stack records; zero dropped events
